scope: PORT-CAS-02 finite null-form and eigenpair/kernel lift algebra
authority: PORT CAS-02, repository hubble_tensor_lift formula, and reviewed TBO-03 admitted for the remaining proof DAG.

domain.h0_h1_q: h0 real, h1 real 3-vector, q real symmetric 3x3 with tr(q)=0

targets: B_ab u^b=0 iff S^a_b u^b=st u^a
tr(q)=0 removes the spatial monopole but does not change the preceding kernel identity
controls: adding a*g to S shifts st by a and leaves B and null contraction unchanged
the unique future timelike eigenline and geodesicity are prerequisites, not outputs
antisymmetric vorticity is not recoverable from S(K,K)
exclusions: existence or uniqueness of a timelike eigenline for arbitrary Lorentz-self-adjoint S
